controls_present.evidence: The tag is the entry identity; an existing entry is updated in place and a re-run is required to leave the file byte-identical apart from changed fields.
Three named failure modes with distinct handling; the retry is bounded at two attempts and only for the plausibly transient lock case; the deterministic failure is explicitly not retried.
Done-when is observable and checkable: file parses, exactly one entry for the tag, prior entries intact. Failure reporting is required not to imply the write happened.
One file written, one read-only command, no network or credentials, stated as a scoping instruction to the host rather than a promise of good behaviour.
The unparseable-ledger guard protects the one output whose corruption is costly, and nothing more.

notes: The positive control for mutating workflows. EX-006 shows the reviewer catches an unsafe mutation; this fixture shows it does not simply raise mutation findings unconditionally. Marking R17-R20 'not applicable' here is a failure — they apply and are satisfied.
change_policy: Frozen for the validation cycle. A new evidence-backed finding is DISPUTED and goes to independent adjudication, recorded here with its evidence, before this fixture changes.
